header.headline: Building clinical AI that can be audited
header.subhead: KONSENXIA is developed by a team that treats architecture documents, legal records, and honest status labels as part of the product.

profile.title: Corporate profile

facts.value: KONSENXIA — healthcare AI for clinician collaboration and AI-assisted consultation
KVKK + GDPR design goals; HIPAA-aligned target posture — architecture, not certification
repo docs/healthcare_ai_architecture.md, docs/legal/*, FAZ_C expert review themes

profile.body: We build for institutions that must answer hard questions about patient data before they can adopt anything. Our architecture and legal documentation are written to be read by clinicians, IT, and compliance officers in the same meeting — with every claim labelled for what it is: designed, planned, or proven.

press.title: For press
bullets: Status labels must be preserved: architecture, roadmap; no certification language without an audit behind it.
Metrics registry (/metrics) is the source for any published figure or posture statement.
No clinical performance claims are authorised beyond sourced material.

investors.title: For investors
bullets: Wedge: procurement-ready data-path clarity (anonymization designed for; KVKK + GDPR design goals).
Moat: architecture and legal docs as product artifacts plus clinician-in-the-loop trust.
Business model: proprietary clinical product under agreement; open landing builds distribution trust.
Narrative with no invented numbers: /metrics → investor narrative.

developers.title: For developers
bullets: Landing repo is dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0 — fork, adapt, ship.
Good first issues: locale (TR/EN/DE), animation, SEO, case studies.
Clinical integrations and API access are handled through contact under agreement.
